changeSet.author: nexus-mz9jv
changeSet.comment: nexus.collection_vector_stats: liveness from one set-based join of nexus.chunks to the live (tenant, collection, chash) set of the manifest and document tables, instead of a chunk_live_owners probe per stored chunk and per FILTER. Same columns, types, grain and results (vectors-019-5 semantics); the plan no longer scales as 2N probes and no longer trips JIT. The view's grants, options and dependents are kept by CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.collection_vector_stats WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, c.collection, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lv.chash IS NOT NULL) AS chunk_count, max(c.created_at) FILTER (WHERE lv.chash IS NOT NULL) AS last_write, count(*) AS stored_count FROM nexus.chunks c LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT m.tenant_id, m.collection, m.chash FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL) lv ON lv.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND lv.collection = c.collection AND lv.chash = c.chash GROUP BY c.tenant_id, c.collection, 3;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.collection_vector_stats WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, c.collection, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash))) AS chunk_count, max(c.created_at) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash))) AS last_write, count(*) AS stored_count FROM nexus.chunks c GROUP BY c.tenant_id, c.collection, 3;
